### Observed differences

- Activity A01 is absent from the earlier window (0 of 200 traces) and occurs in every trace of the later window (200 of 200), exactly once per case and never repeating; its median position is the final event of the trace, with a mean relative position of about 0.94. [OCC001, POS001]
- In the earlier window A01 never co-occurred with A05, A06 or A08 (each of which appears in all traces in both windows); in the later window it co-occurs with each of them in 100 in 100 traces and follows them: after A08 in every case, after A05 in about 87 in 100, and after A06 in about 75 in 100. [REL001, REL002, REL003, POS002, POS003, POS004]
- The flow into A01 comes mainly from A08: A08's outgoing transitions went from A05 (about 51 in 100), A02 (about 24 in 100) and A06 (about 20 in 100) — with no recorded successor in roughly 125 of 200 earlier traces, i.e. A08 often ended the case — to A01 in about 82 in 100 of transitions, now present in all 200 traces. Smaller new inputs to A01 come from A06 (about 11 in 100 of its transitions), A05 (about 6 in 100), and A02 and A04 (about 2 in 100 each). [DIR008, DIR006, DIR005, DIR002, DIR004]
- A01 has a recorded successor in only 53 of the 200 later traces; those transitions lead back to A05 (about 45 in 100) or A06 (about 45 in 100), rarely to A02 or A04. So in roughly 1 in 4 later cases the flow returns from A01 to the A05/A06 stage, while in the remaining about 74 in 100 cases A01 is the last event. [DIR001, POS001]
- The surrounding activities shifted by about one event position: mean positions of A05 (0.52 to 0.44), A06 (0.74 to 0.66) and A08 (0.87 to 0.77) moved earlier; the A08→A06 gap moved about one step later (lag 2: about 52 in 100 to 23 in 100; lag 3: 27 to 46 in 100), as did A08→A05 (within one step: 66 in 100 to 33 in 100); direct A05→A06 succession fell from about 76 in 100 to 63 in 100. [POS002, POS003, POS004, LAG005, LAG004, LAG001]
- Otherwise the routing picture is stable: the successor mixes at A02, A03, A04 and A07 changed only slightly (empirical strengths 0.20–0.66, i.e. within the range of random re-splits), and the A05–A08 and A06–A08 orderings and gaps are essentially unchanged. [DIR002, DIR003, DIR004, DIR007, REL005, LAG002, LAG003]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the hypothesis that a new activity, A01, was introduced at the end of the process: in the later window it runs exactly once in every case, normally as the final step after A08 (and after A05 and A06), whereas in the earlier window cases typically ended at A08 or returned from A08 to A05/A02/A06 without any A01. In about 1 in 4 later cases the flow returns from A01 to A05 or A06, so A01 also sits on the existing A05–A06 loop there. [OCC001, POS001, REL001, REL002, REL003, DIR008, DIR001]

The support is direct and consistent: participation goes from 0 of 200 traces to 200 of 200, the relational items show the placement directly (A01 always after A08, co-occurrence rising from 0 to 100 in 100 with A05/A06/A08), the successor change at A08 is observed outright (A05 about 51 in 100 to A01 about 82 in 100), and the one-step position and lag shifts of A05, A06 and A08 are exactly what appending a final event produces. All key items have empirical strength of about 0.99, and because A01 appears in every later trace while A02–A08 remain observed in essentially every trace in both windows, both a rare-variant explanation and a simple relabelling of an existing activity are ruled out. Limitations: the evidence cannot distinguish a genuinely new step from one that was executed before but not recorded in the earlier window, as both leave the same signature; no expected-by-chance item count is provided, so the overall chance assessment rests on the per-item empirical strengths; and the small shifts at A02–A07 (strengths 0.20–0.66) remain within what unchanged processes produce. [OCC001, REL003, DIR008, POS002, POS003, POS004, LAG004, LAG005, DIR002, DIR003, DIR004, DIR007]

Other differences: A05's successor mix shifted beyond the new A01 edge (A05→A06 down about 13 points to about 63 in 100, with small rises to A03, A04, A07 and A08), A05 precedes A08 somewhat more often (about 71 in 100 to 79 in 100), and the A05→A06 gap shows more lag-2 and lag-3 occurrences — all plausibly ripples of A01's insertion, but not independently confirmed as separate changes. [DIR005, LAG001, REL004]
